root_cause_analysis.diagnostic_question: Why did 50 of 50 in-flight bsubs fail with `Too few tasks requested`?
root_cause_analysis.answer: config/cluster_lsf/cluster_config.yaml L7-L11 header documents NCSU HPC LSF queue policy: serial=1 slot only, standard=min 8 slots 48h max, long=min 2 slots 10d max. Commit 2dcb518 (W4 V2 cluster_config fix) added explicit `queue: long` to the run_finemap rule (was inheriting __default__ serial) to obtain 240-hr wallclock for the SuSiE-RSS layer rebuild under D-TA-04-OVERRIDE-V2 = CONSERVATIVE_BOTH. However, run_finemap retained `threads: 1` from its original spec. config/bsub_wrapper.sh handles -q (queue), -R rusage[mem] (memory in GB conversion), and -W (wall time, set by queue), but does NOT inject or floor -n based on queue policy. Snakemake passes -n {threads} (=1) to bsub. LSF rejects every long-queue submission with -n 1 because long requires -n >= 2.
root_cause_analysis.v1_dispatch_did_not_hit_this: V1 abort fired 96 run_finemap bsubs successfully into serial queue (1-slot OK) before being killed mid-flight; the long-queue regression was introduced after V1 abort, in commit 2dcb518.
root_cause_analysis.config_evidence_path: config/cluster_lsf/cluster_config.yaml line 8 (`#   long:     min 2 slots, 10d max — for heavy compute`); rule prepare_ld_plink at line 23 already follows this pattern (`queue: long, threads: 4`) and would not hit this error. run_finemap with threads: 1 violates the queue policy.

option_E_bump_run_finemap_threads_to_2.description: Edit config/cluster_lsf/cluster_config.yaml: set run_finemap.threads from 1 to 2. Matches the existing prepare_ld_plink pattern (long queue + threads: 4). Snakemake passes -n 2 to bsub; long queue accepts. SuSiE-RSS R code is single-threaded so the 2nd slot is wasted compute (no parallelism inside R), but the slot is allocated and dispatch unblocks.
option_E_bump_run_finemap_threads_to_2.pro: Smallest possible change (1 line YAML); preserves long queue routing intent (240-hr wallclock); follows existing prepare_ld_plink pattern; no driver/wrapper edits
option_E_bump_run_finemap_threads_to_2.con: Allocates 2 slots per run_finemap job for a single-threaded workload — double the slot footprint; 96 jobs * 2 slots = 192 slots peak vs current 96 with threads=1; may slow throughput at queue level if cluster is busy
option_E_bump_run_finemap_threads_to_2.rigor_assessment: matches prepare_ld_plink pattern; well-precedented; minimal footprint
option_E_bump_run_finemap_threads_to_2.wall_estimate_post_fix: ~10-15 hr (CONSERVATIVE_BOTH envelope unchanged from D-TA-04-OVERRIDE-V2 plan)

option_F_floor_n_in_bsub_wrapper.description: Edit config/bsub_wrapper.sh: when QUEUE=long, floor -n to 2 (and to 8 when QUEUE=standard, matching the cluster_config header policy). Adds queue-aware -n flooring logic across ALL rules, not just run_finemap.
option_F_floor_n_in_bsub_wrapper.pro: Centralized fix — any future rule routed to long automatically gets -n>=2 without per-rule YAML edits; makes bsub_wrapper.sh queue-policy-aware (defensible)
option_F_floor_n_in_bsub_wrapper.con: More invasive bsub_wrapper.sh change; touches a shared infrastructure file; risk of regression on other-terminal workflows that share .snakemake (but the wrapper is per-invocation, so other-terminal would not be affected unless restarted); harder to roll back surgically
option_F_floor_n_in_bsub_wrapper.atomic_diff_size: ~10-15 line bash edit (case statement + min logic)
option_F_floor_n_in_bsub_wrapper.rigor_assessment: more defensible long-term but higher blast radius; touches a config file used by every snakemake job in the project

option_G_revert_2dcb518_run_finemap_to_s.description: Revert commit 2dcb518's queue: long fix; put run_finemap back on inherited serial queue (1 slot OK; no submission rejection). However, serial queue's wall-time cap is 5760 min (96 hr / 4 days) per bsub_wrapper.sh L52 — sufficient for V1's niter=100 dispatch but POSSIBLY INSUFFICIENT for honest niter=1000 SuSiE-RSS fits at 32GB RAM (some loci took >2 hr at niter=100 per W3 prod logs; niter=1000 = 10x — could exceed 4 days for the worst loci on cold cache).
option_G_revert_2dcb518_run_finemap_to_s.pro: Single-line YAML revert; restores V1 working state
